Route notes

  • Rok'Alim the Pounder drops a quest item for Thousand Needles.
  • Sharptalon, Shadumbra, Tideress and Ursangous drop quest items in Ashenvale.
  • A section moves to Completed once every step is ticked or skipped. "Completes over time" quests don't hold it back: they carry forward in the yellow tray at the top until you tick or skip them.
